summary: This directory serves as a foundational repository for application-wide data schemas and static type definitions. It centralizes reusable models to ensure structural integrity, consistent data validation, and shared type safety across various domain-specific modules.
responsibilities: Define shared data structures and validation schemas
Provide static TypeScript types for core data entities
Maintain naming and branding standards for domain identifiers
Ensure consistent data validation logic across the application
relationships: Static TypeScript types are derived directly from the schema definitions to ensure type safety.
Branded identifiers enforce strict typing on domain-specific keys, preventing incorrect usage throughout the codebase.
Centralized schema definitions provide a single source of truth for validation rules used across the application.
designDecisions: Consistent use of paired runtime schema constants and static TypeScript types
Utilization of branded types for strict identifier safety
Centralized storage for reusable domain primitives
